The Sentencing Process Guideline
Scottish Sentencing Council report on public consultation exercise
Part 1: Response to public consultation exercise
Approach to providing views

10. The Council’s views on the key points raised in relation to each part of the draft
guideline are set out below. We have also indicated how the guideline submitted
to the High Court for approval will differ as a result of these, and what other action
may be taken.

11. While a brief summary of the key points raised is provided, we suggest that you
refer to the consultation analysis for further context.
General
Examples and explanations

12. One of the most frequently -made suggestions was that the guideline should
provide examples of the application of a part of the process, such as sentencing
for multiple offending, sentence discounting, or consider ation of time spent in
custody.
